title: Gorehands Belly Plate Torso
html:
Monster drop: Warchief Ruk Gorehand

How to get it

Unique. Dropped by Warchief Ruk Gorehand on 2% of kills (10% from an elite). Built on Titanium Torso; bound, so it can’t be traded. Unique items can’t be reforged.

  • A kill heals you for 3% of your maximum hitpoints.
  • +15% damage while you are below 40% hitpoints.

See Unique items for all of them.
